title: console: record-page lookup links carry no `/_console` base path, so open-in-new-tab or a copied link lands on ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND (objectui#12211 item 4)
body:
Filing gate ①: a reproduced product defect, split from list card objectstack-ai/objectui#12211 (item 4) as triage `6121957396` directs ("The dispatching seat splits it per item into sub-issues"). This card carries item 4 only. The parent keeps the items not yet split and closes when every item is split and closed.

Parent: objectstack-ai/objectui#12211. Domain and priority are inherited from the parent (`domain:ui`, `priority:p3`); `area:records` per triage.
Reader: the `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_01G5TSaEwbEQsKMjhzTB4rEd`), which split it and dispatches it.
Dedupe: the parent's table, item 4: `link href _console`, 13 hits, nearest objectui#11769 (closed: the public-form URL). No newer card covers it (the parent was filed 2026-10-12).

## What happens (from the parent, item 4)

Source: the 2026-10-12 hosted-shape browser pass of HotCRM 4.0.1 on a cloud rig at production v1.36.0's pins (objectui `d758f2f20d`), zh-CN.

- **Reach:** the 转化 section links (account, contact) and the owner (`sys_user`) links on a lead page.
- The href reads `…:5650/apps/app.objectstack.hotcrm/crm_account/record/RECORD_ID?from=…`. It is missing `/_console`.
- A left-click works, because the SPA router intercepts it.
- Open-in-new-tab, a middle-click or a copied link lands on a page whose whole body is `{"success":false,"error":{"code":"ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND","message":"Not found"}}`. The direct open was measured once. The bad hrefs were seen on account, contact and user links.

## Acceptance

Record-page lookup links carry the console base path, so the same href works from a left-click, a new tab and a copied link.
